doc.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Who was in Gillespie's band
summary: Wilder recalls trumpet section members Dave Burns, Lammar Wright Jr., Elmon Wright, Al McKibbon and Howard Johnson.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Who else was in the band at that point, when you joined Dizzy’s band?

Dave Burns was in the trumpet section, Lammar Wright, Jr., Ike – I can’t think of his last name. There were several people who came. Elmon Wright was in the band at one time. Al McKibbon, the bass player, was with him. Who played piano? I’m trying to remember.
Howard Johnson was playing alto with him. It’s funny that I can’t remember everybody that was in. But they had a bunch of fine players.
